opening.argument: The video actively urges viewers toward paid OneCoin packages, beginning with a "30 euros" activation package that provides "a position with one coin." It then presents substantially more expensive packages, including a €5,000 option visibly listed alongside token, coin, business-volume and daily allocations with Upgrade buttons. The higher-priced package is promoted through "60,000 free tokens for mining" and the claim that company splits will "double the amount of tokens that you have to use for mining." The speaker further calls it "probably going to be your best value between these two packages," reinforcing a direct recommendation to purchase paid mining access rather than merely describing the packages. The presentation also associates these packages with tokens, points, commissions and payout claims as benefits.
